partner_result.application: For a heavy row r_i=sqrt(c)e and V spanning e-perp, (R_-V)^T(R_-V)=I_2, so the partner theorem gives ||p_Y||_infinity<=e for Y=V^T R_-^T X_-.

new_results.statement: For exact rank three with max leverage alpha<1/3, ||p_Q||_infinity<=12(1-3alpha)^(-1/6)|det Lambda|^(-1/3), with continuity.
The heavy-row disintegration has ||p_Y||_infinity<=e and ||p_(T|Y=y)||_infinity<=c^(-1/2), while preserving the full spectral quadratic matrix.

Those marginal/conditional density caps alone do not bound an indefinite rank-three quadratic pushforward; an explicit independent T and unit-density hyperbolic strip Y gives density scale at least delta^(-1/2).
